parsed.rationale: Both participating records live inside test targets: `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Although neither record carries `is_test: true` in its context flags, both file paths are unambiguously under `Tests/` directories, making them test fixtures by location. Lifting `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` into shared production code would couple production targets to test-only semantics, which is the canonical restraint pattern. The duplication is intentional: each test file defines its own local mock to satisfy its own test scope.
